overall: The 18 sites are clearly 6 variants each of three businesses (bike workshop Lowgear, yoga studio Kiln Yoga, solicitors Hartwell & Okafor), and they visibly share one component kit, which is the biggest giveaway when seen side by side (a single site in isolation looks much better than the set). Recognisable groups: (1) 'poster grotesk' template (s01, s06, s08, s09, s14, s16, partly s02/s17): numbered eyebrows '02 / ...', numbered service rows 01-04 with description on the right, marquee ticker band, 1-4 steps, big stat band, rotating '14' badge, giant wordmark footer. (2) 'dark tasteful serif' template (s04, s07, s11, s18): deep green or navy, italic serif, centered logo header, label-left/list-right sections, values rows, tan/gold pull-quote band. (3) 'soft card' template (s03, s05, s12, s13, s15): split hero with rounded image card, feature block with 'ALSO' sidebar list, Q/A rows, 'Dear reader' letter or sticky note, accordion plus grid fake map with a single dot. Cross-cutting tells: italic-question / answer-right rows on almost every page, often followed by a second accordion FAQ; grid-pattern fake map with a dot; hand-drawn underline/circle scribbles; script signatures. Visible bugs that betray a template: empty stat bands with the big number missing (s06, s10, s13, s14), placeholder text left in (s15 regulation note, s16 address), email wrapping in s14. What saves the set from 'Lovable slop': copy is unusually specific and voiced (railway arch, 14 mats, smell of bread, 20 minute call, fixed fee), no purple gradients, no icon-card trios, no stock people, and the bespoke line illustrations (arch, floor plan, oven, desk with clock, front door) are the strongest human signal. Strongest: s01 (single-colour poster, cropped SAME DAY band, short and confident), then s10, s14, s11, s16, s07. Weakest: s04, s18, s05, s12, s15, s13, s08 (s08 by stacking every kit component; s15 by generic headline and anonymous three-column testimonials). Recommendation: vary or drop the recurring kit pieces (accordion plus fake map, Q/A rows, marquee, giant footer wordmark, scribble underline), fix empty stat slots, and lean harder on the per-business illustration and one bold layout move per site.
